name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1. An alternate replacement for scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev, not a stage alongside them. Requires workspace-init.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a release as a skeleton and drive it from Release 0 through MVP and v1.
interface.longDescription: Ossify plans a release as a skeleton, drives its spine round by round, and closes it with a ceremony that harvests what the round learned. It replaces the scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev pair rather than composing with them — install one lifecycle or the other, not both. It also requires workspace-init: the first entry point refuses fail-fast until a workspace-init pairing manifest exists. The grill and the adversarial critic are internal (the challenge skill) since 1.1.0, so the release-planning veto and the spine-close audit run on every install; an external fresh-frame adversary joins close-depth audits when one is configured. One limit on Codex specifically: round execution dispatches an implementer subagent that only the Claude Code and OpenCode surfaces register.
defaultPrompt: Onboard this project's spec core with ossify.
Open the next release and plan its spine.
